scripts.code:
set -euo pipefail

VCF='/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/04.重测序/Part6.GWAS/data/Real_snp.vcf.gz'
PHENO='/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/04.重测序/Part6.GWAS/data/Real_trait.C16_0.table'
QMAT='/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/04.重测序/Part6.GWAS/data/Real_snp.3.Q'
GFF='/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/04.重测序/Part6.GWAS/data/Real.gff3'

CHECK_DIR='/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/biomind_agent_benchmark/runs/task_outputs/session_1789648505/plan_artifacts/00.input_check'
LOGS_DIR='/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/biomind_agent_benchmark/runs/task_outputs/session_1789648505/plan_artifacts/logs'
VCF_SAMPLES="${CHECK_DIR}/vcf.samples.txt"
PHENO_SAMPLES="${CHECK_DIR}/phenotype.samples.txt"
Q_SAMPLES="${CHECK_DIR}/q.samples.txt"

mkdir -p "${CHECK_DIR}" "${LOGS_DIR}"

# ---- 1. 正式输入存在性、可读性与大小（只读） ----
for f in "${VCF}" "${PHENO}" "${QMAT}" "${GFF}"; do
  if [ -r "${f}" ]; then
    sz=$(stat -c '%s' "${f}")
    printf 'INPUT_OK\t%s\t%s bytes\n' "${f}" "${sz}"
  else
    printf 'INPUT_MISSING_OR_UNREADABLE\t%s\n' "${f}"
    exit 1
  fi
done

# ---- 2. 依赖探测（缺失只记录，不失败） ----
DEPS="${CHECK_DIR}/dependency_status.tsv"
printf 'tool\tstatus\tversion_or_path\n' > "${DEPS}"

probe() {
  name="$1"; shift
  if command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ver=$("$@" 2>&1 | head -n 1 || true)
    printf '%s\tavailable\t%s\n' "${name}" "${ver}" >> "${DEPS}"
  else
    printf '%s\tmissing\tcommand not found: %s\n' "${name}" "$1" >> "${DEPS}"
  fi
}

probe bcftools bcftools --version
probe plink plink --version
probe plink2 plink2 --version
probe emmax-intel64 emmax-intel64
probe emmax emmax
probe emmax-kin-intel64 emmax-kin-intel64
probe Rscript Rscript --version
probe bedtools bedtools --version
cat "${DEPS}"

# ---- 3. VCF 样本列表（bcftools 可用时） ----
if command -v bcftools >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  bcftools query -l "${VCF}" > "${VCF_SAMPLES}"
  printf 'VCF_SAMPLE_COUNT\t%s\n' "$(wc -l < "${VCF_SAMPLES}")"
  bcftools view -h "${VCF}" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 5 > "${CHECK_DIR}/vcf.header.tail.txt" || true
else
  : > "${VCF_SAMPLES}"
  printf 'VCF_SAMPLE_COUNT\tNA\tbcftools missing: cannot list VCF samples\n'
fi

# ---- 4. 表型表与 Q 矩阵样本 ID（按首列提取，只读） ----
awk 'NR>1 && $1!="" {print $1}' "${PHENO}" > "${PHENO_SAMPLES}"
awk '{print $1}' "${QMAT}" > "${Q_SAMPLES}"
printf 'PHENOTYPE_SAMPLE_COUNT\t%s\n' "$(wc -l < "${PHENO_SAMPLES}")"
printf 'Q_SAMPLE_COUNT\t%s\n' "$(wc -l < "${Q_SAMPLES}")"

# ---- 5. 输入结构摘要（表头/前几行，只读） ----
head -n 3 "${PHENO}" > "${CHECK_DIR}/phenotype.head.txt"
head -n 3 "${QMAT}" > "${CHECK_DIR}/qmatrix.head.txt"
head -n 3 "${GFF}" > "${CHECK_DIR}/gff3.head.txt"
printf 'PHENOTYPE_HEADER\t%s\n' "$(head -n 1 "${PHENO}")"
printf 'QMATRIX_FIRST_LINE\t%s\n' "$(head -n 1 "${QMAT}")"

# ---- 6. 产物非空校验 ----
for f in "${VCF_SAMPLES}" "${PHENO_SAMPLES}" "${Q_SAMPLES}"; do
  if [ ! -s "${f}" ]; then
    printf 'EMPTY_ARTIFACT\t%s\n' "${f}"
  fi
done
test -d "${CHECK_DIR}"
test -d "${LOGS_DIR}"
printf 'INPUT_CHECK_DONE\n'
